user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with only a title and no optional fields so that minimal input is sufficient.

positive.title: Create a task with only a title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a valid title for the task.
positive.expected_result: The task is created successfully with the specified title.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with an empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title cannot be empty.

edge.title: Create a task with a very long title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page.
Enter a title that exceeds the maximum character limit for titles.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title exceeds the maximum length.
